name: Benchmark_Dataset-Primate_mammal_species_classification
description:
Summary
	

This dataset provides a benchmark for evaluating the model's capability to identify species-specific genomic signatures across varying evolutionary distances. 
Using whole-genome assembly data from seven diverse mammals—including four primates (Human, Pan troglodytes, Pongo abelii, Callithrix) and three non-primates (Mouse, Cattle, Sheep)—we designed a multi-class species classification task.

reputation: A specialized genomics benchmark hosted by BGI on Hugging Face aimed at research use; adoption is currently limited to genomics and computational biology communities.
